hero.name: Bakir
hero.tagline: Launching my own projects since I was 15.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm in 11th grade and applying to university in Vienna. I launched my first project in Turkey at 15: evening open-air film screenings.
Since then I've launched five projects of my own, worked as a product manager at an EdTech startup and recently captained a basketball team. I've run more than 200 user interviews.
I lead teams from the inside: I understand almost every part of a startup, from customer discovery to code. Right now I'm looking for my niche.

items.name: Trajectory
items.task: Connect a student, their parents, companies and universities through a “Digital DNA” — a living profile of interests, skills and strengths.
items.did: The idea, customer discovery and all the engineering. I built the team and pitched the project at Startup Village 2026.
items.result: 6 written cooperation agreements with schools, companies and a senator.
results: Special award at the All-Russian Entrepreneurship Olympiad
6 written cooperation agreements: schools, companies, a senator

items.name: Teya
items.tag: My own project · AI for psychologists
items.task: After a session, a psychologist needs to record and make sense of the case quickly.
items.did: I ran in-depth interviews with psychologists and launched the product: the psychologist dictates their thoughts, and Teya turns them into a structured note and a running case memory.

items.name: Bakir OS
items.tag: My own operating system · AI agent
items.task: My own operating system: a second brain in Telegram.
items.did: A Claude-based bot that decides which tool to call: it records ideas, tracks finances, transcribes voice messages and remembers project context.

items.name: Foundation Lab
items.did: I ran the AI tutor and the AI personal-brand projects: user interviews, hypotheses, launch.

items.name: Websites for small businesses
items.task: A small business needs a site that makes sense on a phone within one screen.
items.did: I built a multi-agent pipeline on Claude Code: audit → copy → build → critique. Deployed to GitHub Pages and Vercel.
items.result: Three live demos — open them and check.

items.name: Twilight Cinema
items.task: Launch my first project of my own.
items.did: Evening open-air screenings in Altınkum with Croissant Atelier café: “The Little Prince”, “Up”, free entry.
